name: Tina
source:
A skilled swordsman and one of the heroines who destroyed Leila's true father Aruzargu. Instantly smitten by the adorable and childlike qualities of the newly hatched Leila she can't help but rape her.

After that Chris forces her to take care of the young dragon girl who now has many questions about what it was that her 'papa' was doing to her once she hatched.
